tools.name: move_ticket_to_queue
tools.description: Moves a support ticket to a different team queue and records the new queue and a reassignment note on the ticket.

params.name: ticket_id
params.description: ID of the ticket to move

params.name: destination_queue
params.description: Name of the queue to move the ticket into

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("support-tickets")
DATABASE_PATH = "support.db"


@mcp.tool()
def move_ticket_to_queue(ticket_id: int, destination_queue: str, reassignment_note: str = "") -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    current_timestamp_iso = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    with database_connection:
        update_cursor = database_connection.execute(
            "UPDATE tickets SET queue = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
            (destination_queue, current_timestamp_iso, ticket_id),
        )
        if update_cursor.rowcount == 0:
            database_connection.close()
            return f"Ticket {ticket_id} not found"
        database_connection.execute(
            "INSERT INTO ticket_notes (ticket_id, body, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
            (ticket_id, f"Moved to {destination_queue}. {reassignment_note}", current_timestamp_iso),
        )
    database_connection.close()
    return f"Ticket {ticket_id} moved to {destination_queue}"

tools.name: issue_ticket_refund
tools.description: Refunds a payment tied to a support ticket through Stripe, and grants the customer's account a temporary supporter access role when the refund is over the configured threshold.

params.name: ticket_id
params.description: ID of the ticket the refund belongs to

params.name: grant_priority_access
params.description: Whether to give the customer priority support access

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3

import stripe
from agents import function_tool

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_API_KEY"]
DB = "support.db"
MAX_CENTS = 50000


@function_tool
def issue_ticket_refund(ticket_id: int, payment_intent_id: str, amount_cents: int, grant_priority_access: bool = False) -> str:
    if amount_cents <= 0:
        return "Amount must be positive"
    if amount_cents > MAX_CENTS:
        return "Amount exceeds the refund limit"
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    row = con.execute(
        "SELECT customer_id FROM tickets WHERE id = ?", (ticket_id,)
    ).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        con.close()
        return f"Ticket {ticket_id} not found"
    cid = row[0]
    try:
        ref = stripe.Refund.create(
            payment_intent=payment_intent_id,
            amount=amount_cents,
            metadata={"ticket_id": str(ticket_id)},
        )
    except stripe.error.StripeError as e:
        con.close()
        return f"Refund failed: {e}"
    msg = f"Refunded {amount_cents} cents (refund {ref.id})"
    if grant_priority_access:
        with con:
            con.execute(
                "UPDATE customers SET support_role = 'priority' WHERE id = ?",
                (cid,),
            )
        msg += "; priority support access granted"
    con.close()
    return msg

tools.name: escalate_ticket_to_manager
tools.description: Updates a ticket to escalated status with a reason, and transfers ownership of the ticket from its current agent to a manager who is also given access to the ticket.

params.name: ticket_id
params.description: ID of the ticket to escalate

params.name: manager_id
params.description: ID of the manager taking ownership

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone


def escalate_ticket_to_manager(db_path: str, ticket_id: int, manager_id: int, reason: str) -> dict:
    con = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    previous = con.execute(
        "SELECT owner_id FROM tickets WHERE id = ?", (ticket_id,)
    ).fetchone()
    previous_owner = previous[0] if previous else None
    with con:
        con.execute(
            "UPDATE tickets SET status = 'escalated', escalation_reason = ?, owner_id = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
            (reason, manager_id, now, ticket_id),
        )
        con.execute(
            "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO ticket_access (ticket_id, user_id, level) VALUES (?, ?, 'manage')",
            (ticket_id, manager_id),
        )
        con.execute(
            "UPDATE ticket_access SET level = 'view' WHERE ticket_id = ? AND user_id = ?",
            (ticket_id, previous_owner),
        )
        con.execute(
            "INSERT INTO ticket_events (ticket_id, kind, detail, created_at) VALUES (?, 'escalated', ?, ?)",
            (ticket_id, reason, now),
        )
    con.close()
    return {
        "ticket_id": ticket_id,
        "previous_owner": previous_owner,
        "new_owner": manager_id,
        "status": "escalated",
    }

tools.name: purge_spam_tickets
tools.description: Permanently deletes tickets marked as spam that are older than a given number of days, along with their comments and attachments records.

params.name: minimum_age_in_days
params.description: Only spam tickets older than this many days are deleted

params.name: maximum_tickets_to_delete
params.description: Upper limit on how many tickets to delete in one call

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("support-tickets")
DATABASE_PATH = "support.db"


@mcp.tool()
def purge_spam_tickets(minimum_age_in_days: int, maximum_tickets_to_delete: int = 100) -> str:
    if minimum_age_in_days < 1:
        return "minimum_age_in_days must be at least 1"
    if maximum_tickets_to_delete < 1:
        return "maximum_tickets_to_delete must be at least 1"
    cutoff_timestamp_iso = (
        datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(days=minimum_age_in_days)
    ).isoformat()
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    spam_ticket_rows = database_connection.execute(
        "SELECT id FROM tickets WHERE status = 'spam' AND created_at < ? ORDER BY created_at LIMIT ?",
        (cutoff_timestamp_iso, maximum_tickets_to_delete),
    ).fetchall()
    spam_ticket_ids = [row[0] for row in spam_ticket_rows]
    if not spam_ticket_ids:
        database_connection.close()
        return "No spam tickets matched"
    placeholder_string = ",".join("?" for _ in spam_ticket_ids)
    with database_connection:
        database_connection.execute(
            f"DELETE FROM ticket_comments WHERE ticket_id IN ({placeholder_string})",
            spam_ticket_ids,
        )
        database_connection.execute(
            f"DELETE FROM ticket_attachments WHERE ticket_id IN ({placeholder_string})",
            spam_ticket_ids,
        )
        deletion_cursor = database_connection.execute(
            f"DELETE FROM tickets WHERE id IN ({placeholder_string})",
            spam_ticket_ids,
        )
    deleted_ticket_count = deletion_cursor.rowcount
    database_connection.close()
    return f"Deleted {deleted_ticket_count} spam tickets"
